title: New Orleans Paranormal Society Private Ghost Hunt
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please call before booking if you have mobility issues.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Want to have a ghost hunt with just your group? Here is your chance. Book a 2 location ghost hunt inside some of the most haunted places in the French Quarter. Price includes up to 12 participants from age 8 and up. Children under 8 are not permitted on this experience. Entrance fees and use of and instruction about the equipment also included. You will learn to use some of the most state-of-the-art equipment and ground breaking techniques to help illicit responses. This is NOT a walking tour with stories, you are inside and performing an investigation with the assistance of our investigators. 

Tour guide gratuities are NOT included in the tour price.
